mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -36.9 at t-3w to -32.4 at t-0w, a four-week upward momentum; this gradual reopening momentum continues and lifts the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -36.9 to -32.4 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has recovered to -1.3, crossing the -5% threshold; near-normal essential errand activity signals consumer willingness to leave home, which spills into retail and recreation within two weeks.
failure_condition: After GROCERY_PHARM crosses -5.0, RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks is lower than its last two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous t-0w drops in TRANSIT (-31.4) and WORKPLACES (-35.4) indicate renewed movement restrictions and remote-work mandates; reduced commuting trips suppress retail-and-recreation footfall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls >= 2 points week-on-week and WORKPLACES falls >= 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -29.0 to -31.4 and WORKPLACES fell from -27.7 to -35.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both drop by those thresholds, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In Delhi's winter pollution regime, PARKS remains below -55%; outdoor leisure is suppressed and spending rotates into indoor retail venues, supporting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: In weeks when PARKS <= -55.0, the subsequent two-week mean of RETAIL_REC falls below the prior two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has stayed above +9.6 for four weeks and rose to +11.6 at t-0w, indicating persistent stay-at-home behavior; fewer home-to-retail trips depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to the last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +9.6.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES fell 7.7 points in the last week to -35.4, a threshold break indicating new workplace restrictions; offices closing again removes commuter-driven retail demand in the next week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -27.7 to -35.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the week after WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points, RETAIL_REC rises week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp t-0w improvement in GROCERY_PHARM to -1.3, after -8.0 at t-3w, signals a temporary essential-shopping surge that will mean-revert; as grocery trips normalize downward, retail-and-recreation mobility also falls over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM jumped to -1.3 at t-0w from -5.3 at t-1w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to the last 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM mean-reverts below -5.0.

mechanism_narrative: The spread between GROCERY_PHARM (-1.3) and RETAIL_REC (-32.4) exceeds 30 points, indicating retail is lagging essential activity; this gap closes upward as retail catches up over the next week.
failure_condition: When the GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap exceeds 25 points, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days does not rise above its prior 7-day mean.
